sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id AS patient_id
FROM (
    SELECT
        client_id,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(
            DAY,
            MAX(return_visit_date),
            :endDate
        ) AS ltfp_days
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
    WHERE encounter_date <= :endDate
      AND return_visit_date >= :startDate
    GROUP BY client_id
) a

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT *
    FROM person p
    WHERE p.dead = 1
      AND p.death_date <= :endDate
) p
    ON a.client_id = p.person_id

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT mf_to.client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_transfer_out mf_to
    LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mf_ti
        ON mf_to.client_id = mf_ti.client_id
    WHERE mf_to.transfer_out_date <= :endDate
      AND (
          mf_to.transfer_out_date > mf_ti.transfer_in_date
          OR mf_ti.client_id IS NULL
      )
) mfto
    ON a.client_id = mfto.client_id

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT x.client_id
    FROM (
        SELECT
            client_id,
            TIMESTAMPDIFF(
                DAY,
                MAX(return_visit_date),
                DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
            ) AS ltfp_days
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
        WHERE encounter_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
          AND return_visit_date <= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        GROUP BY client_id
    ) x
    WHERE x.ltfp_days > 28
) lost_in_previous_quarter
    ON a.client_id = lost_in_previous_quarter.client_id

INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT client_id
    FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
    WHERE special_category = 'In prison'
) special_category
    ON a.client_id = special_category.client_id

WHERE a.ltfp_days <= 28
  AND p.person_id IS NULL
  AND mfto.client_id IS NULL;
